verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents itself as an MCP *server* that exposes its own scraping/automation tools to AI models (hyperbrowser-docs-8, hyperbrowser-gh-1, hyperbrowser-probe-4), but this is the opposite of the story, which asks whether Hyperbrowser (or its HyperAgent/browser-agent features) can act as an MCP *client* and plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence describes Hyperbrowser consuming or connecting to third-party MCP servers.
